\chapter{Constants and names}\label{app:canon}
Every constant and name in this book is taken from one file, \texttt{CANON/iam\_canon.json}; this appendix is generated from it. Terms are defined in the Glossary (Appendix~\ref{app:glossary}).
\section*{The symbols}
\begin{center}\small\begin{tabular}{p{0.12\textwidth}p{0.8\textwidth}}\toprule
$A$ & reading $/$ the healthy or as-built reading of the same system, the same meaning in every domain; $A=1$ is healthy, $H_{\min}$ the floor below it\\
$H_{\min}$ & the floor: chips $k_BT_j\ln2$; qubits the thermal floor $p_{\rm eq}t_g/T_1$ at the temperature the record sees; cells the cell type's reference floor (Met-A) or $P_{\rm cell}H(\varepsilon_0)$ (IAM-A)\\
$\varepsilon$ & qubits: $-\ln(1-p_{2Q})$, the gate error in nats; cells: the per-molecule held error\\
$M$ & $E/k_BT$ (cells $20.94$; chips $A\ln2$); $M/\ln2$ in Landauer units\\
$p_{\rm eq}$ & thermal occupation of the wrong level of a record, $1/(1+e^{hf/k_BT})$; one gate owes $p_{\rm eq}t_g/T_1$\\\bottomrule
\end{tabular}\end{center}

\section*{Names in use}
{\small\begin{longtable}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.24\textwidth}p{0.7\textwidth}}\toprule
name & definition\\\midrule\endhead
IAM's law & Every irreversible transition from quantum superposition to classical record pays k\_B T ln 2 per bit to the nearest encoding surface at the local temperature. \emph{Note:} The performance-floor relationship of the device gauges is named the IAM floor.\\\iamrowrule
Mahaffey number (M) & The drive ratio: drive energy over the thermal noise quantum, M = E\_drive/(k\_B T). Sets the operating regime; for a record held in a gap hf, M = hf/(k\_B T) and its thermal floor is 1/(1+e\textasciicircum{}M). Cell: 20.94 (30.2 in Landauer units). Chips: M = E\_sw/(k\_B T\_j) = A x ln 2 (chip gauge). The only quantity named 'Mahaffey'.\\\iamrowrule
IAM floor & Synonym of H\_min (the floor): the lowest error a system can hold at its temperature before thermal kicks win.\\\iamrowrule
Informational fidelity ratio (A) & A = reading / the same system's healthy reading (the healthy reference), measured on the same instrument. Dimensionless; A = 1 is the system working as itself, in the middle of the gauge. Below it lies H\_min, the lowest error the system can hold before thermal kicks win; nothing reads below H\_min. Above 1 = more error than healthy. Cells: Met-A = mean H(beta) over identity sites / the healthy reference (purified healthy cells, same platform); IAM-A = H(eps)/(P\_cell H(eps0)). Qubits: eps/eps(as built), eps = -ln(1-p). Chips: E\_sw/E\_sw(as built). A is never the temperature exponent n. \emph{Note:} One meaning of A in every domain: the reading over the healthy or as-built reading of the same system. For qubits the gate error in nats is epsilon = -ln(1-p\_2Q); A is epsilon over the device's as-built value.\\\iamrowrule
Landauer metrology & Measuring how far above its thermal floor an information-writing process operates, against a fixed physical zero, in any substrate.\\\iamrowrule
MethylPhys CPG & The cell instrument: Methylation Physics, Cellular Performance Gauge. Reads cells' methylation (Met-A, IAM-A) and places them on the gauge.\\\iamrowrule
Met-A (Metrology A) & Array reading of ONE cell type in one specimen (chain Stage M): Met-A = mean over the cell's identity sites of H(beta) / H\_min(cell), H(b) = -b log2 b - (1-b) log2(1-b). H\_min(cell) = the same quantity on purified healthy cells of the same type on the same platform, through the chain's own Stage 1 (constant Met\_A\_floor\_EPIC\_neutrophil; site rule Met\_A\_site\_rule); >= 90 \% of the identity sites must be measured. Whole blood: the denominator is the composition-matched healthy expectation mean\_i H(sum\_c f\_c mu\_c,i), with the specimen's own fractions f (Stage A, EPIC blood NNLS) and purified healthy profiles mu (no group comparison; PROC-WB-NEUT-01); read at any neutrophil fraction with its own detection limit (DEV-LOWFRAC-01; no fixed fraction cut). Stage T tare: against >= 3 healthy references run the same way (same slide, else same batch), A\_rel = A / median(reference A); with >= 20 reference records the noise-corrected tare A = a + b f\_neu + c N (N = noise index, mean H(beta) over 48,528 fixed sites; DEV-NOISE-02). The gauge state is printed on A\_rel only; without references the reading is reported as untared. Each reading carries its detection limit (smallest loss of the cell's pattern the specimen could show). Commissioned 2026-10-09 on isolated neutrophils, EPIC v1; whole blood is read and printed with the note that it has not yet been tested with Met-A; 450K and EPIC v2 refused. Normal 0.95-1.05. Information theory only; no energy content. Expansion: Informational Metrology A score.\\\iamrowrule
IAM-A & Error reading on single-molecule sequencing, each sample against its own reference: IAM-A = eps / eps\_pred(L). eps is the held error (isolated unmethylated calls between two methylated calls, over the interior calls of qualifying molecules: at least 6 calls, at least 80 \% held), counted by chain Stage Q2; L is the sample's own loose share (share of 2,000-CpG tiles held below 70 \%); eps\_pred(L) = 0.040265 + 0.034625 L is the healthy self-reference line, measured once on 153 healthy samples of 56 cell types (chain/Runtime Matrices/IAM\_A\_SelfRef/selfref\_line\_v1.json). No other specimen is a reference. Normal band v1: 0.779-1.055 (band\_v1.json). Before reading, the sample-shape check declines a sample whose tile distribution is outside the healthy shape of its cell type (shape\_reference\_v1.json). Ends on the gauge are the sample's own: full surface 0.5/eps\_pred(L) (12.42 at L = 0, 6.68 at L = 1). Commissioned 2026-10-17 on healthy blood CD8 T cells, whole-genome bisulfite sequencing (COMMISSIONING\_NOTE\_IAMA.md); other cell types are read and printed with the note that they have not yet been tested with IAM-A. The earlier position form, H(eps)/(P\_cell H(eps0)), is retired (development flag only).\\\iamrowrule
Salmon-A & Not a separate quantity: IAM-A read by the salmonid chain (body temperature = water temperature).\\\iamrowrule
C-score (sky-map C-score) & Clustering of a specimen's residual sky map on the Met-A identity sites: c = var(sqrt(10) x the means of 10 consecutive sites in genome order) / var(z), over the site variance; C = c / c\_healthy, c\_healthy = 1.0103 (leave-one-out median of the six reference arrays; neutrophil\_reference\_v1\_2.json), so healthy reads 1 on the same gauge as A. Read one-sided against the healthy band 0.877-1.152 after the same-run tare (above 1.152 is a clustered departure). Commissioned 2026-10-15 on whole blood, EPIC v1 (COMMISSIONING\_NOTE\_CSCORE.md). Chain v4 also draws the map on a HEALPix sphere (NSIDE 128, nested order) in the report; nothing is scored from the drawing. A cosmology map statistic, not a physics floor. On first use in papers write 'sky-map C-score'. Blocks of 50 and baseline 1.1104 were the construction before 2026-10-09.\\\iamrowrule
H\_min (the floor) & The absolute lowest error a system can hold before thermal kicks win; below it the system no longer exists as itself. It is NOT the denominator of A and NOT 1: it sits below 1 at H\_min / healthy reference. Cells: thermal kicks win against one full ATP per site, held error 1/(1+e\textasciicircum{}M) = 8.1e-10, H\_min = 2.5e-8 bits (1e-7 on the IAM-A gauge, 8e-8 on Met-A, neutrophils). It is NOT the healthy reference height H\_ref = H(eps0) = 0.2043 bits. Qubits: the thermal floor p\_eq t\_g/T1, p\_eq = 1/(1+exp(hf/(k\_B T))) at the temperature the qubit's record sees. Chips: the Landauer floor k\_B T\_j ln 2. \emph{Note:} The absolute lowest point a system can operate at before thermal kicks win.\\\iamrowrule
One gauge (convention) & Every score is an error score on one gauge: A = 1 is healthy in the middle, H\_min below it is the floor nothing passes, above 1 is more error; a failure point may lie on the high side (qubits: error correction fails near p = 1 \%). Each domain keeps its field's form. Always quote a value with its score's name. \emph{Note:} Adopted 2026-10-02: each domain is read with its own physics, so the formulas are not forced to be identical.\\\iamrowrule
Healthy reference & The denominator of A: the same system's healthy reading on the same instrument. Cells: Met-A, the purified healthy cells of that type on that platform (EPIC neutrophils 0.330263 bits; constant name Met\_A\_floor\_* kept for the chain until the SOP rename); IAM-A, P\_cell H\_ref = P\_cell H(eps0) (neutrophils 0.2348 bits). Devices: the device as built.\\\iamrowrule
Thermal floor (qubit) & The qubit H\_min and the left-hand mark of the qubit gauge: IAM's Law at the temperature the record sees. p\_eq = 1/(1+exp(hf/(k\_B T))) for the held record; p\_eq t\_g/T1 for one gate of duration t\_g (detailed balance).\\\iamrowrule
H\_ref (healthy reference height) & Cells: where healthy cells actually hold their methylated sites, H(eps0) = 0.2043 bits (E\_hold 3.41 kT, measured across 56 healthy cell types; about half hold better than it). Each cell type's own IAM-A healthy reference is P\_cell H\_ref (neutrophils 0.2348 bits). Measured, not a limit; the floor is H\_min. The distance from H\_min to H\_ref in energy is phi = 0.16 of one ATP.\\
\bottomrule\end{longtable}}
